text:
Claire: Design check-in: playground streaming UX — new ideas for collapse behavior + prompt-library affordances.
Claire: Problem: users mistake tiny streamed fragments for a stuck model. Proposal: after 500ms of low throughput, collapse the trailing fragments into a compact chip that reads "Stream paused — 5 tokens" and shows a chevron to expand buffered text. Primary action on the chip should be context-aware: 'Resume' if runtime.can_resume, otherwise 'Regenerate'.
Ezra: Love the chevron expand. Two quick notes: 1) we should surface a tiny confidence pill when available (e.g., "~40%") but only if confidence>0.6 and show it with a tilde. 2) add an option in preferences for users to auto-collapse streams or always show fragments.
Maya: Accessibility: don't keep announcing every small fragment. Keep the streaming region aria-live=polite for chunk updates. When we collapse, write once to a role=status region: "Stream paused, 5 tokens buffered. Actions available: resume, regenerate, copy." Ensure the chip is focusable (tabindex=0) and does not steal focus.
Ruben: Implementation tip: we can use runtime.meta.buffered_token_count and runtime.meta.can_resume. For expand behavior, send a small preview fetch that returns buffered_text only (no extra token charge) so users can inspect partial output without regenerating. Also provide a keyboard toggle ("e") to expand/collapse the buffered preview.
Claire: Microcopy options for the chip (visual):
- "Stream paused — 5 tokens"
- "Streaming paused: 5 tokens buffered"
- "Output paused (5 tokens)"
Which is most succinct and clear?
Ezra: I prefer "Stream paused — 5 tokens". Short and matches other UI. For the chevron tooltip: "Show buffered preview" (must be keyboard accessible).
a11y-bot: Accessibility checklist: chunkRegion aria-live=polite; pauseAnnouncer role=status updated once on collapse; chip tabindex=0 + aria-label that reads full phrase and available actions; tooltips appear on focus; provide visible 2px focus ring and ensure color contrast > 4.5:1. Do not set aria-atomic=true for the whole stream region; that causes entire content to reannounce.
Maya: Good call on aria-atomic. Also, for screen reader power users add a user pref in settings: "Announce every token" (off by default). That helps researchers.
Ruben: Token footprint: show a subtle label next to the timestamp like "• 19 tks"; clicking the label toggles pin for that conversation. Tooltip: "Token usage for this response" and must appear on keyboard focus.
Claire: Prompt library integration: if the response used a saved prompt, show a tiny link "from prompt: <name>" in message meta. When stream pauses, the chip secondary action should be "Edit prompt" which opens prompt editor with the original variables prefilled.
Ezra: Telemetry: events = playground.stream_collapsed, playground.preview_buffered_open, playground.resume_click, playground.regenerate_click. Payload: { buffered_tokens, can_resume, trigger } where trigger is one of [network, user, runtime]. Keep IDs minimal and avoid PII.
Maya: Keyboard shortcuts: Resume = Cmd/Ctrl+Enter, Regenerate = Shift+Cmd/Ctrl+Enter, Expand preview = E, Toggle token pin = P. Put hints in the tooltip and keyboard help modal.
Ruben: Styling: chip uses subtle shadow and slide-up animation when appearing to indicate state change. On mobile the chip becomes full-width and actions move to the bottom sheet. Long-press opens the same actions on mobile.
Claire: A/B test ideas: (A) show chevron+expand preview vs (B) open actions directly; (C) wording test: 'Resume' vs 'Continue' as primary action. Measure confusion (help clicks) and regenerate rates.
Maya: I'll draft the a11y PR checklist and include sample code for the announcer. Example snippet to announce once on collapse:
```
const announcer = document.getElementById('pause-announcer');
announcer.textContent = `Stream paused, ${buffered} tokens buffered.`;
// announcer has role="status"
```
Claire: Thanks all. Ruben please spike the buffered preview + chevron today and share a preview branch. We'll aim to ship a small prototype behind a flag. :rocket:
a11y-bot: Demo branch created: playground/stream-collapse-preview — preview: https://preview.redwood.ai/playground/stream-collapse-preview
Claire: Great — ping here when PR is up for review.
